meta.name: add-clidash
meta.description: Add clidash — a zero-dependency, read-only web dashboard that derives its tabs and tables at runtime from any CLI that lists resources as JSON. Ships pre-wired for NanoClaw's ncl CLI (agent groups, sessions, channels, users, roles), plus message-activity charts, a log tail, and a read-only file viewer for group skills/CLAUDE.md/profiles.

copy.tagline: 将任意 JSON 输出 CLI 转为实时 Web 仪表盘
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你有输出 JSON 的 CLI 工具，想快速生成 Web 仪表盘
copy.tagline_en: Turn any JSON-output CLI into a live web dashboard
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have a CLI that outputs JSON and want a quick web dashboard

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会把 clidash 复制进 tools/,写好配置并启动一个只读网页面板;它按 CLI 输出的 JSON 资源自动生成标签页和表格,并附 agent 概览、消息活动图、日志与文件查看。
howto.when: 当你执行 /add-clidash,想给 NanoClaw 或任意输出 JSON 的 CLI(如 docker、kubectl)加一个只读面板时触发。

say.text: 把 clidash 装到 tools/ 并启动,绑在 127.0.0.1
say.note: 它会复制目录、写配置并运行 server.js

say.text: 给 clidash 配置加一个 docker 的 jsonlines 资源

howto.what_en: After install, Claude copies clidash into tools/, writes a config and starts a read-only web dashboard that derives tabs and tables from any CLI listing resources as JSON, plus agent overview, activity, logs and file views.
howto.when_en: No use-when trigger in the description. Typically triggered when you run /add-clidash to give NanoClaw, or any CLI that lists JSON such as docker or kubectl, a read-only dashboard.

say_en.text: Install clidash into tools/ and start it on 127.0.0.1
say_en.note: Copies the dir, writes config, runs server.js
